title: fix(plugin-hono-server): a Hono door's 409 DELETE_RESTRICTED, and every structured refusal, carries RestServer's arm fields (#23587)
body:
Part of #23587
Clause-②: no

This lands the card's three structured fields on both Hono doors, under one rule that covers every arm of `RestServer`'s classification. It also corrects the published error pages this answer changes (patch rounds 1 and 2, the seat's reviews `6185187566` and `6186145904`). What stays on the card is one location, folded there as its remainder by the seat's pointer `6185197160`: `declaredEnvelopeForThrow` answers the engine's `DuplicateRecordError` as `409 DUPLICATE_RECORD` on both Hono doors, where `RestServer` answers `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` with `developerMessage`, `field` and `object`. The governing text is the maintainer ruling recorded at commit `65846bc46`: one wire spelling on every route. This PR's agreement rule leaves that code alone on purpose.

## What this does

The engine refuses the delete of a record that a `deleteBehavior: 'restrict'` lookup still references with `409 DELETE_RESTRICTED`. `RestServer`'s single-record `DELETE` answers it through `mapDataError`, whose first step is `structuredCodeAnswer` (`@objectstack/types`). That arm carries the engine's `developerMessage`, `dependentObject`, `dependentCount` and the route's `object` beside the code. Both Hono doors answered the same throw with `code` and `message` only. They are `@objectstack/hono`'s `createHonoApp` (its `dispatch()` catch-all, through `thrownJson`) and a route mounted on `HonoHttpServer` (`wrap()`, and the transport `onError` seam). All of them render through `declaredEnvelopeForThrow` in `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts`.

Measured on a real `createHonoApp` over the real engine and protocol (SQLite WASM), at `16abea884`:

- FROM `409 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"DELETE_RESTRICTED","message":"This Parent is still referenced by 1 Child record(s) through “Parent”. Delete or reassign them first."}}`
- TO the same, plus `"details":{"developerMessage":"Cannot delete parent (ID): 1 dependent child record(s) reference it via parent. Delete or reassign them first, or set deleteBehavior:'cascade' on child.parent.","dependentObject":"child","dependentCount":1}`

PR #23582 added a helper beside the recogniser that read the arm for `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` only. This PR widens it from one code to every arm that agrees with the envelope already decided, and renames it from `declaredConflictContext` to `declaredArmContext`, since it no longer reads only conflicts:

- **The arm must agree on status and code.** It can add context to the envelope, never change it. An arm that answers a different code is not consulted.
- **Everything the arm's body carries is forwarded except three keys:** its own sentence and code (the envelope already carries them as `message` and `code`), and `currentRecord`, which stays held by name (#23586, unchanged from PR #23582).
- ⛔ No field and no code is listed. Each field appears only when the producer stated it, by the arm's own rule, so a producer's narrowing passes through as it stands. The engine withholds `dependentCount` when the caller's own identity would not see the same rows (`dependentCountIsDisclosable`), and then the door sends no count either.
- **Where they land:** `error.details`, as PR #23582 placed `currentVersion`. On the REST wire every arm field is a top-level member of the flat body, and that body has no `details`. On the wrapped envelope the only declared context slot is `ApiErrorSchema.details`, since `developerMessage`, `dependentObject` and `dependentCount` are not `ApiErrorSchema` members. `@objectstack/client` reads `error.details = errorBody.details ?? errorBody.error.details ?? errorBody` (`packages/client/src/index.ts`), so a client sees the same keys under `err.details` from either door. ⛔ No third spelling of the refusal body.

Status, `code` and `message` do not move on any answer. The REST door's answer is unchanged. `@objectstack/hono`'s source is unchanged too: `createHonoApp` renders through `declaredEnvelopeForThrow`.

## Every arm, checked

Each arm of `structuredCodeAnswer` is listed below, with what `RestServer` sends and what the Hono doors send before and after. Readings marked "measured" come from a real `createHonoApp` at `16abea884` (before) and `d1a39b380` (after). The rest come from the producer-shaped rows in the unit file and the code read.

| code (status) | `RestServer` (`mapDataError`) | Hono doors before | Hono doors after | not forwarded, and why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DELETE_RESTRICTED` (409) | `developerMessage`, `dependentObject`, `dependentCount`, `object` | none (measured) | `developerMessage`, `dependentObject`, `dependentCount` (measured) | `object`: the arm takes it from the route only |
| `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` (409) | `currentVersion`, `currentRecord`, `object` | `currentVersion` | `currentVersion` (unchanged) | `currentRecord`: held, #23586. `object`: route only |
| `METADATA_CONFLICT` (409) | `currentVersion`, `object` | none | `currentVersion`, on a route mounted on `HonoHttpServer` | `object`: route only. On `createHonoApp` the `/meta` save is answered by the dispatcher's own `errorFromThrown`, so it never reaches the recogniser. Measured unchanged there; see Acceptance notes (#22222) |
| `INVALID_FIELD` (400) | `field`, `object` | none (measured) | `field`, `object` (measured) | none |
| `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` (404) | `object` | none (measured) | `object` (measured) | none. The arm's fixed sentence is not taken: the envelope keeps the thrown `message` |
| `FEEDS_DISABLED`, `FILES_DISABLED`, `ATTACHMENT_PARENT_ACCESS`, `ATTACHMENT_DELETE_DENIED`, `RECORD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE` (403) | `object` | none | `object` | none |
| `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400) | `fields`, `object` | `fields` (the resolver's) | `fields`, the same array | `object`: route only. `validationFailureDetails` and the arm read `fields` alike, so the merge is byte-identical |
| `DUPLICATE_RECORD`, answered by REST as `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` (409) | `developerMessage`, `field`, `object` | none, code `DUPLICATE_RECORD` (measured) | unchanged (measured) | the arm answers a different code, so it is not consulted. This is the card's remainder (opening paragraph) |
| `ERR_DATASOURCE_UNAVAILABLE` (503) | `datasource`, `reason`, `object` | the recogniser declines | unchanged | its one producer (`DatasourceUnavailableError`, `@objectstack/objectql`) declares no `status`, so the recogniser never answers it |
| `OBJECT_API_DISABLED`, `OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` | `object`, `allowed` | none | unchanged | the arm fires only when it is given a route object that differs from the error's own, and the recogniser gives none |

**System-context reads (#23586's question, asked of every arm).** `currentRecord` is the only field read with a system context and left unnarrowed. Every other field is one of these:
- a version token (`currentVersion`);
- an API name (`object`, `dependentObject`, `field`);
- the caller's own input;
- a sentence that names the same API names (`developerMessage`).

`DELETE_RESTRICTED`'s dependents probe is elevated. But the engine discloses the count, in `dependentCount` and in `developerMessage`, only when the caller's own identity would have read the same rows (`dependentCountIsDisclosable`, `@objectstack/objectql`). It names the dependent object unconditionally, by that ruling's constraint 2. `RestServer` already sends all of it to the same caller. So `currentRecord` stays the one exclusion, by name. The helper's docblock says that an arm which grows such a field must be held there by name in the same way.

**Sandboxed producers.** A `SandboxError` carries only `code`, `fields`, `status`, `userMessage` and `innerMessage` (`runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts`). So no arm adds a field from one. `VALIDATION_FAILED`'s `fields` is the resolver's own array, and `INVALID_FIELD` and `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` decline a sandbox origin themselves.

## What stays off these doors

- **`object` on `DELETE_RESTRICTED`, `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` and `METADATA_CONFLICT`.** Those arms add the object the ROUTE named (`mapDataError(error, req.params.object)`). `declaredEnvelopeForThrow` has no route, so it asks the arm without one, as PR #23582 recorded for `CONCURRENT_UPDATE`. The caller named that object in its own URL. ⛔ It is not substituted from the error's own `object`. The engine's cascade recurses through the public `delete(childName, …)`, so a restrict deeper in a cascade names the child it was deleting, not the object the route addressed, and REST would answer differently. **Decided** by the seat (review `6185187566`, option A): the field is not owed at these doors. This follows the family precedent, PR #23582, which landed `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` without it, and #23531's Landed comment `6183626856`, which names `currentRecord` as that card's only remainder.
- **`currentRecord`:** held, #23586, as before. The two absence pins from PR #23582 are unchanged and green.

## Tests

- **Pins.** Both files keep their existing controls, and the #23531 blocks are unchanged.
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/handler-throw-declared-envelope.test.ts`, the new `[#23587]` block, 14 rows on direct-mount routes:
    - `DELETE_RESTRICTED` with the count, with the count withheld, and in the subflow guard's shape, which states no field and keeps the two-key envelope;
    - `METADATA_CONFLICT` with a token and with `null`;
    - `INVALID_FIELD`, `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`, and the five 403 access codes;
    - two guard rows: an arm whose status, or whose code, differs from the declared one is not consulted.
    - Each refusal row asserts status, `code` and `error.details` exactly.
  - `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/hono-declared-envelope.conformance.test.ts`, the new `[#23587]` block, 3 rows on a real `createHonoApp`:
    - a restricted `DELETE` (account and contact, `restrict`): `error.details` equals the `developerMessage`, `dependentObject` and `dependentCount` of the throw the engine really raised, read off the `deleteData` call. The row also asserts that throw stated a string `developerMessage`, so the equality cannot hold between two absences, and that the parent row is still stored;
    - `GET /data/task?nosuchfield=1`: `400 INVALID_FIELD` with `{ field, object }`;
    - `GET /data/ghost`: `404 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` with `{ object }`.
- **Red before the fix** (pins only, `90574de90`, on the unfixed recogniser): unit `Tests 11 failed | 26 passed (37)`, conformance `Tests 3 failed | 15 passed (18)`. Every red row failed at its `error.details` assertion with `expected undefined to deeply equal …`. The three guard rows pass on the unfixed tree by construction; they are the regression half.
- **Ablation**, on `d1a39b380`. Two legs, each run with `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, with an outer `trap … EXIT INT TERM` restore against the absolute path. Each leg rebuilt `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`, and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` found the marker in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs` before either suite ran.
  - **Leg A** narrowed the helper back to one code. The anchor ``const arm = structuredCodeAnswer(thrown);`` became a read guarded on `resolved.code === 'CONCURRENT_UPDATE'`, carrying the marker `ABLATION_23587_ONE_CODE` (blob `7fd1f090b0` to `11a3ca30af`). Every new `[#23587]` refusal row went RED, and the `[#23531]` rows stayed green: unit `Tests 11 failed | 26 passed (37)`, conformance `Tests 3 failed | 15 passed (18)`, each at `expected undefined to deeply equal …`.
  - **Leg B** dropped the held field. The anchor ``&& key !== 'currentRecord'),`` became a key no body carries, `ABLATION_23587_HELD_FIELD` (blob to `1f5ac3cbb6`). Exactly the four `currentRecord` absence pins went RED: unit `Tests 2 failed | 35 passed (37)`, `expected { …(2) } to deeply equal { Object (currentVersion) }`; conformance `Tests 2 failed | 16 passed (18)`, `to not have property "currentRecord"`. The conformance body then carried the system-context row the real protocol states (`organization_id`, `owner_id`, `created_by` and the rest). That is the disclosure the exclusion holds back.
  - **Restore:** the blob equals HEAD (`7fd1f090b0`), `git diff HEAD` is empty and `git status --porcelain` is clean. After a rebuild, preflight `--absent` found both markers gone from all 6 built files, with a clean tree. Both pin files were green again: unit `37 passed (37)`, conformance `18 passed (18)`.
- **Packages**, at `d1a39b380`, after a rebuild of `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` (the conformance file reads its `dist/`):
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-hono-server typecheck` (tsc, `tsconfig.typecheck.json`, `check:test-typecheck` OK, 0 debt) and `test`: `Test Files 29 passed (29)`, `Tests 354 passed (354)`.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/http-conformance typecheck` (`check:test-typecheck` OK, ledger unchanged) and `test`: `Test Files 13 passed (13)`, `Tests 142 passed (142)`.
- **Patch rounds 1 and 2 (docs only, heads `83c418436` and `9675127f3`).** No package file changed since `d1a39b380`, so the package suites above stand. The docs readings were taken with scratch files that were not committed: R1 on the `createHonoApp` rig, and R2 on one kernel, comparing a composed host (`@objectstack/rest`'s routes registered, then `createHonoApp` mounted) with `createHonoApp` alone. See "Docs corrected (patch rounds 1 and 2)".
- `@objectstack/hono`'s own suite is not run locally: its source is untouched, and its vitest config stubs `@objectstack/runtime`. The composed-host pins above cover its door. It is declared to CI.

- `--ran` reconciliation: `95 derived, 95 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (a derived zero).
- The docs gates on the touched pages, among them, all exit 0: `check:doc-anchors`, `@objectstack/spec check:docs`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:docs-redirects`, `check:docs-single-h1`, `check:docs-spec-enumerations`, `check:doc-frontmatter`, `check:docs-section-name` and `check:section-landing-index`.

- ⚠️ The derivation reports a stale tree: this branch is 16 commits behind `origin/main` (`7c6b7f4a3`), and 11 gate files changed across that range. So the local run read this branch's copies of those scripts. None of those commits touches the 7 changed paths, and `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main` is clean, so the branch is not merged (after a PR opens, `main` is merged only on a conflict, a main-caused red or a queue removal). CI runs the merge ref, which carries the current scripts.
- CI on `9675127f3`, read once: 41 check-runs, 36 success, 5 skipped, none failed or in progress.
- Round 1 (`83c418436`) gave the same 95-family result. Round 0 (code head `d1a39b380`): 66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED; `eslint --no-inline-config` over the two touched packages exit 0. The patch rounds change no lintable source.

## Changeset

`.changeset/23587-hono-structured-arm-fields.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` `patch`. `@objectstack/hono` is not named, because its source does not change, and both packages are in one fixed version group. The body gives FROM and TO for `DELETE_RESTRICTED`, names the other arms the rule now covers, and says which two fields stay off and why.

## Docs corrected (patch rounds 1 and 2)

Head `9675127f3`: round 1's commit `83c418436`, then round 2's `9675127f3`, which scopes the sentences that assumed every `createHonoApp` host serves `/data` through the dispatcher (the seat's review `6186145904`). Line numbers are given on that head, with the `origin/main` lines in brackets; those three files are unchanged on `main` since the merge base. Readings:
- **R1:** a real `createHonoApp` host alone, over the real engine and protocol (SQLite WASM), at `d1a39b380`, the code these rounds do not change. A scratch file, not committed, with `RestServer`'s body for each request computed from the same thrown error by `mapDataError`.
- **R2:** one kernel (engine, `HonoServerPlugin`, `createRestApiPlugin`) at `9675127f3`. Two hosts were measured:
  - the hosted composition: `@objectstack/rest`'s routes registered on the Hono app, then `createHonoApp` mounted on it with `route('/', …)` (the `ALL /api/v1/*` catch-all present);
  - `createHonoApp` alone, over the same kernel.

  A scratch file, not committed.
- **U:** the `[#23587]` unit pins on a `HonoHttpServer` route.
- **6110136480:** the maintainer's hosted measurement on #22222, for `/meta` on the hosted composition (flat, from the REST door).

R1 measured, per code, on the Hono door and then the REST twin:
- `DELETE_RESTRICTED`: nested, `details` `{developerMessage, dependentObject, dependentCount}` / flat with those three and `object`.
- `CONCURRENT_UPDATE`: nested, `details` `{currentVersion}` / flat with `currentVersion`, `currentRecord`, `object`.
- `INVALID_FIELD`: nested, `{field, object}` / flat with both.
- `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`: nested, `{object}`, message `Object 'ghost' not found` / flat, `error` `Object 'ghost' is not registered`.
- `VALIDATION_FAILED` (a missing required field): nested, `{fields}` / flat with `fields` and `object`.
- A duplicate insert: nested `DUPLICATE_RECORD`, no `details` / flat `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` with `developerMessage`, `field`, `object`.
- None of the six Hono bodies carries `httpStatus`.

R2 measured, on the hosted composition and then on `createHonoApp` alone:
- the same restricted `DELETE /api/v1/data/account/ID`: `409` **flat** `{error, code: DELETE_RESTRICTED, developerMessage, dependentObject, dependentCount: 1, object: "account"}` / `409` **nested** with those three under `error.details`;
- `GET /api/v1/data/account?nosuchfield=1`: `400` **flat** `INVALID_FIELD` with `field` and `object` / `400` **nested** with `{field, object}` under `error.details`.

**The bounded in-place rule, for `VALIDATION_FAILED`.** This PR leaves that code's Hono-door body byte-identical. Four lines were false in the same way and are corrected: `:406`-`:407`, `:409`-`:410`, `:1052`-`:1054` and `:1103`-`:1105`. Each condition was checked:
1. **Same defect class:** a published statement that a refusal is never nested, or has no `details`, which is false at the Hono doors.
2. **Mechanical, with the shape pinned:** R1 measured `error.details.fields`, and `handler-throw-declared-envelope.test.ts` already pins it on a direct-mount route.
3. **No other claim holds the file:** the seat's pointer `6185197160` read all 15 open PRs.
4. **Same gate family:** the docs gates on the same page, with no new verification surface.

## Found, not fixed here

- **The published duplicate-record statements**, which this PR does not change. The bounded in-place rule fails its second condition here: the shape is not settled, because the card's remainder changes the code these doors answer. Carrier: #23587's remainder. On a `createHonoApp` host a duplicate insert was measured as `409 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"DUPLICATE_RECORD","message":"Duplicate record refused on 'task': …"}}`, at `16abea884` and again at `d1a39b380`. These lines say otherwise, and they are left as they stand:
  - `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx:668` (`:609` on `origin/main`): `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` "flat … so it is never nested".
  - `:680`-`:683` (`:621`-`:624` on `origin/main`): "every route answers the wire code `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` and the in-process spelling never crosses HTTP".
  - `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx:507`-`:510`: the same sentence.
  - `:75`-`:76` of the corrected corollary keeps `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` "always flat". That holds for every reading taken: no Hono door answered `UNIQUE_VIOLATION`. It moves with the remainder.

## Acceptance notes

- `createHonoApp`'s `/meta` save answers `409 METADATA_CONFLICT` through the runtime dispatcher's own writer (`HttpDispatcher.errorFromThrown`), without `currentVersion`. Measured at `16abea884`, on a host with no `@objectstack/rest` route ahead of the catch-all. This is #22222's question, closed `not_planned` on the maintainer's hosted measurement `6110136480`: a hosted `PUT /meta` reaches `RestServer`, not the catch-all. Its triage `6056494314` set the build shape for the catch-all case: a declared `ApiErrorSchema` member in `packages/spec`, not this file. Not refiled.
